data.name: Greshma
data.long_meaning: Greshma means 'Warm Grace' in Sanskrit and 'Peaceful Warmth' in Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Grih' (home) and 'Sham' (warmth). This name symbolizes the feeling of being at home in one's own self and experiencing inner peace and warmth.
data.spiritual_meaning: Greshma is a name of divine origin. It represents the grace of the Goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and happiness. Greshma is a reminder of the inner peace and warmth that comes from connecting with the divine.
data.numerology_meaning: Greshma is a 1 Life Path Name. People with this name are natural leaders, innovators, and pioneers. They are often ambitious, creative, and have a strong will power.
